answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 10 epochs. Receipts are issued in tide, burned on slash in delta, and listed in jetty. That removes the yield anyone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. A farm of 2970 identities would post 1247 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
